title: Marcos, Angara honor homecoming tennis star Alex Eala

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and Education Secretary Sonny Angara pushed for a stronger grassroots sports development program as they welcomed home tennis star Alex Eala on Tuesday, celebrating her historic rise in international tennis. According to a statement from the Department of Education (DepEd) on Tuesday, Marcos and Angara joined Eala at the Eusebio Gymnasium of Pasig Central Elementary School, where they engaged in some ceremonial tennis action before around 1,000 students and officials. Eala, who recently reached a career-high World No. 15 in the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) singles rankings, made history for Philippine tennis by […]...
